question: Find the id, last name and cell phone of the professionals who live in the state of Indiana or have performed more than nine treatments.
gold_query: SELECT professional_id , last_name , cell_number FROM Professionals WHERE state = 'Indiana' UNION SELECT T1.professional_id , T1.last_name , T1.cell_number FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id GROUP BY T1.professional_id HAVING count(*) > 9
